_comment: 3 videos x 10 questions. Question types: factual (3), summary (2), multi_hop (2), follow_up (2), off_topic (1). A follow_up question MUST set follow_up_to to the id of the question it follows, and must come directly after it — that is what exercises the router.

questions.question: What figure did the speaker give for X?
questions.ground_truth: The speaker said X is 42 per cent.
questions.evidence: quote or timecode from the transcript that proves the ground truth

questions.question: What is the main argument of the video?
How does the point made at the start relate to the example given near the end?
questions.evidence: must require at least two distant transcript fragments

questions.question: Can you say more about that?
questions.evidence: answerable from the context retrieved for q7 — this is the from_context branch

questions.question: What is the capital of Australia?
questions.ground_truth: The video does not discuss this; the system should refuse or state that the transcript contains no such information.

videos.title: Long podcast or interview, tests scaling
